name: Buffon noodle extension to smooth 3D curves

insights: 3D smooth Buffon follows same axiomatization pattern as 2D in BuffonsNoodle.lean
Arc length in 3D uses component-wise integration: sqrt(x'^2 + y'^2 + z'^2)
The 2 axioms isolate exactly what Mathlib lacks: Cauchy-Crofton on Gr(2,3)
Lipschitz constant 1/(2d) in 3D is tighter than 2/(pid) in 2D
Shape independence, monotonicity, approximation all proved from the axiomatized formula
Universal 2D/3D crossing ratio 4/pi applies to smooth curves as well as polygonal
builtItems: arcLength3D_const: constant curve has zero arc length
smooth3DExpectedCrossings: axiom for smooth expected crossings
smooth3D_shape_independence: shape independence for C1 3D curves
knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Full formalization of smooth 3D Buffon noodle formula with 2 axioms, 0 sorries, 15 theorems. Extends BuffonsNeedleOQ02.lean from polygonal to smooth curves.
